YOUR ACCOUNT. YOUR CHOICE.

Delete your
FirstLane account.

You don’t need the app installed to do this. Verify your email address, review what deletion means, and confirm your choice.

What gets deleted?

Deleting your account removes your sign-in account and account-linked profile, synced practice history, preferences and reports from FirstLane’s active application database.

  • Your FirstLane account can no longer be used to sign in.
  • Synced practice history and account-linked reports are removed.
  • Account-linked purchase-access records are removed; restoration to that deleted FirstLane account may no longer be possible.
This is permanent. It is not a refund request.

We cannot recover deleted study history for you. Apple or Google keeps its own purchase records. Use the store’s process for a refund; deleting FirstLane does not create one.

What may remain?

Limited transaction-event, refund, security and legal records may be retained for specific obligations or dispute handling. Restricted backups expire under the retention schedule, and processor-held records follow the relevant removal process. See retention and deletion details.

Deleting from this website cannot remotely erase study data on an offline device. Remove local FirstLane data or uninstall the app on devices you control.

How long does it take?

After confirmation, FirstLane attempts to remove your active account immediately. The website only confirms deletion after the account service confirms it. Other eligible records and backups follow the retention schedule.

Prefer to do it in the app?

Open Profile → Your account → Delete account and follow the confirmation steps.

Lost access to your email?

Use Support for help verifying account ownership another way. Do not send us a password or verification code.

Delete this account?

Your email has been verified. This permanently removes your FirstLane account and its synced study history. It does not request a store refund.

Your FirstLane account
has been deleted.

The account service has confirmed deletion. Eligible retained records and backups are handled as described in the Privacy policy. No refund has been requested.
